interface.title: HyetiaScan 2.1.2
interface.stage_of_work: data cleaning and exploratory analysis of rain events
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a rain-gauge (pluviometer) time series, fix duplicate, negative, outlier and missing readings, then find rainfall events and describe them with Huff curves, frequency curves, intensity histograms and rolling-window accumulations.

data.note: I uploaded lluvia_ejemplo_5min.csv with the default load settings (decimal point, utf-8). It has 12955 readings at 5-minute intervals from 2024-03-01 to 2024-04-14, in the columns fechahora (datetime64) and precipitacion_mm (float64). Before cleaning the app counted 6 missing, 2 duplicate, 1 corrupt and 1 outlier reading, with a total of 643.4 mm. After cleaning there were 12960 correct readings and 605.5 mm. With the expected settings (duplicates keep first, corrupt delete, outliers delete, missing as zero) it found 30 events, as the repository says it should.

features.name: Abnormal-reading audit with per-type fix policies
features.general: Count and plot the bad readings in a time series by type, choose a fix for each type, and watch the counts drop until the data are clean enough for later steps
features.specific: The Lecturas anormales stacked bar chart and type filter, next to Control de lecturas anormales (Duplicadas, Corruptas, Atípicas with Umbral atípicas, Perdidas) and the reading-quality pie chart. The Eventos tab stays blocked until none remain.
steps: look at the stacked bar chart and pie of perdidas/duplicadas/corruptas/atípicas
filter the chart to the types of interest and hover a bar to date it
choose a fix for duplicates (keep first/last, sum, average, delete)
delete corrupt (negative) readings and outliers above an adjustable threshold
set missing readings to zero; the pie shows 100% correct and Eventos unlocks
serves_tasks: Choose a fix for each kind of bad reading until none remain
Find where the abnormal readings are in time

features.name: Time-aggregated totals chart
features.general: Switch a cumulative-total chart between day, month and year bins and hover to read values
features.specific: Lecturas agrupadas line chart with Dia/Mes/Año radio buttons, plus the Detalle de lecturas grouped table
steps: choose Dia, Mes or Año
hover a point to read the date and P_acumulada
expand Detalle de lecturas to see the grouped counts per bin
serves_tasks: Look at the totals over time and the share of bad readings

features.name: Threshold-based event segmentation
features.general: Split a continuous series into discrete episodes using minimum/maximum duration, minimum intensity, maximum gap and a rule for gaps exactly at the limit, limited to a date window, with summary statistics updating live
features.specific: Eventos parameter column (Fecha inicial/final, Duración mínima/máxima, Intensidad mínima, Pausa máxima, Manejo de pausa máxima Incluir/Separar) feeding Estadísticas de eventos
steps: pick the date window with the calendars
set minimum and maximum duration
set minimum intensity (mm/h)
set maximum pause and whether a pause of exactly that length is included or splits the event
read the event count and the describe() table
serves_tasks: Split the series into events using duration, intensity and dry-spell rules
Limit the analysis to a date window

features.name: Huff dimensionless mass curves with adjustable resolution
features.general: Classify each event by the quarter of its duration in which most of its rain falls, plot the average cumulative curve for each class, and change the percentile step and read the values as a table
features.specific: Huff tab: Q1–Q4 curves of % precipitation against % duration, the Intervalo de percentiles slider and the Ver valores percentiles popover. Q_Huff is also available as an event column.
steps: open the Huff tab to see the Q1–Q4 curves
drag Intervalo de percentiles (5–50)
open Ver valores percentiles for the numbers
add Q_Huff to the event table to see each event's class
serves_tasks: Characterise how rain is spread through each event
List the events with chosen attributes and summary statistics

features.name: Exceedance-probability curves by class
features.general: Plot exceedance probability against event duration and depth, overall and for each class, with interpolated lookup tables
features.specific: Frecuencia tab: Duracion and P_acumulada against Probabilidad (General, Q1–Q4), plus the 'Probabilidad (interpolada) vs …' tables
steps: open the Frecuencia tab
compare the General and per-quartile curves
read the interpolated value for a probability in the tables
serves_tasks: Compare event duration and depth against exceedance probability

features.name: Binned intensity histogram by class
features.general: Group events into a chosen number of intensity bins and show counts per class as grouped bars
features.specific: Rangos tab with the Número de rangos slider (2–10) and bars coloured by Huff quartile
steps: open the Rangos tab
drag Número de rangos
read the counts per range and quartile

features.name: Rolling-window maximum accumulation table
features.general: For each event, compute the accumulated amount over fixed rolling windows and summarise each window across events
features.specific: Acumulados tab: Estadísticas de acumulados (lapso 10–120 min) and the Detalle de acumulados table per event
steps: open the Acumulados tab
read the count/mean/quantiles for each lapse
look at the per-event table (None where an event is shorter than the lapse)
serves_tasks: Summarise the largest accumulation over rolling windows

features.name: Configurable event table
features.general: Choose which attributes to show in a results table, set how many rows to show, and search within it
features.specific: Columnas a visualizar multiselect (inicia, termina, duracion, P_acumulada, intensidad, conteo, lecturas, porcentajes, Q_Huff), the Cantidad a visualizar slider and the dataframe Search
steps: add or remove columns in Columnas a visualizar
set the number of rows
search the table, e.g. for 'Q4'
serves_tasks: List the events with chosen attributes and summary statistics

features.name: Time-series file import with parsing options and type detection
features.general: Import a delimited time-series file with a chosen decimal separator and text encoding, see which columns were detected as time and value with their data types, choose the value column, and preview a chosen number of rows
features.specific: Archivo tab: Configurar carga (Separador decimal Punto/Coma, Codificación utf-8/utf-16/utf-32/latin-1/iso-8859-1/ascii), the Upload button, the 'Seleccione columna de precipitación' dropdown, the preview table with detected dtypes (fechahora datetime64[s], precipitacion_mm float64) and the Cantidad a visualizar slider. With the wrong decimal separator no numeric column is found and the analysis stops.
steps: set the decimal separator and encoding in Configurar carga
upload the CSV
check the detected time and value columns and their dtypes
choose the precipitation column from the dropdown
set how many preview rows to show
serves_tasks: Load a time-series file and confirm which columns hold time and value
